s.t:
Buscamos a una persona con experiencia comprobable para liderar el día a día del almacén en un entorno aeroportuario.
Experiencia: 2 años de experiencia en un puesto similar.
Escolaridad: Licenciatura concluida en Administración o afín (preferentemente con título y cédula).
Licencia de manejo: Vigente.
Herramientas: manejo de Excel y Office.
Comunicación y calidad: excelente ortografía.
Disponibilidad: disponibilidad de tiempo.
Liderazgo: manejo de personal.
Desempeño bajo presión: capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y responder a la urgencia operativa.
Habilidades técnicas: conocimiento básico de herramientas mecánicas y eléctricas.
En SINTRA valoramos el compromiso, la responsabilidad y la capacidad de mantener el orden en situaciones cambiantes. Nuestro enfoque es que el equipo actúe con criterio, puntualidad y disciplina operativa, asegurando que el almacén sea un soporte real para las necesidades del aeropuerto.
Como Encargado de Almacén en el Aeropuerto de San José del Cabo, nuestro objetivo es asegurar que el almacén opere con control, eficiencia y calidad para que la operación aeroportuaria no se detenga.
Administrar y supervisar el almacén: resguardo de materiales, organización e inventarios.
Coordinar entradas y salidas de mercancía, asegurando exactitud y trazabilidad.
Planear y asignar actividades al personal del área, verificando el cumplimiento de tareas.
Tomar decisiones asertivas ante incidencias, faltantes o urgencias operativas.
Trabajar con alto sentido de urgencia y bajo presión, manteniendo la continuidad del servicio.
Registrar y dar seguimiento a la información operativa utilizando Excel y herramientas de Office.
Apoyar con conocimiento básico en herramientas mecánicas y eléctricas cuando sea necesario para la operación.
Garantizar orden y apego a procedimientos para mantener un almacén confiable y seguro.
Experiencia en entornos operativos con alto flujo de entradas y salidas.
Conocimiento y práctica de controles básicos de inventario (mermas, faltantes y resguardo).
Iniciativa para proponer mejoras en procesos del almacén.
Actitud colaborativa para coordinarse con otras áreas del aeropuerto.
Estabilidad laboral.
Prestaciones de Ley.
Horario: lunes a viernes de 8:00 a 18:00 horas.
Sueldo mensual de $17,861 brutos .
Vales de despensa: $1,534 mensuales .

Votre mission
Für unseren Kunden, ein international tätiges Unternehmen in der Region Biel/Bienne, suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und durchsetzungsstarke Führungspersönlichkeit im Bereich Logistik.

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Funktion übernehmen Sie die personelle Führung eines grösseren Warehouse-Teams und sorgen für einen reibungslosen Ablauf im Outbound-Bereich.

Ihre Tätigkeiten -Personelle und disziplinarische Führung eines Teams von rund 30 Mitarbeitenden -Verantwortung für die Einsatzplanung sowie die Sicherstellung eines effizienten Tagesgeschäfts im Outbound-Bereich -Führung, Förderung und Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden sowie Durchführung von Mitarbeitergesprächen -Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den operativen Teamleitern (Lead Picking, Lead Packing und Lead Customization) -Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Unternehmensrichtlinien -Professioneller Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Mitarbeiter- und Konfliktsituationen -Identifikation und Umsetzung von Optimierungsmassnahmen in den Lagerprozessen -Aktive Präsenz im Lager sowie Unterstützung des operativen Teams bei Bedarf -Zusammenarbeit mit dem Warehouse Manager und weiteren internen Schnittstellen
Votre profil
Ihr Profil -Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Logistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation -Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Logistik -Erste Führungserfahrung im Warehouse- oder Logistikbereich -Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie verhandlungssichere Deutsch oder Französischkenntnisse -Durchsetzungsstarke, belastbare und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit -Freude an der Führung von Mitarbeitenden in einem dynamischen und multikulturellen Umfeld -Hands-on-Mentalität sowie Bereitschaft, nahe am operativen Geschäft zu arbeiten -Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

Job Title: Warehouse & Fulfillment Manager
Location: Remote Department: Manufacturing
Reports To: Head, Manufacturing & Supply Chain
About Herbal Goodness
Herbal Goodness is a premium wellness company specializing in nutrient-rich, organic herbal products sourced ethically from Africa and Latin America. We are a mission-driven, minority-owned business that donates 10% of our profits to educate girls in Africa through our WAAW Foundation. We’re growing fast and seeking passionate, values-driven team members to join our leadership team.

The Warehouse & Fulfillment Manager will oversee all aspects of warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, picking, packing, and order processing, to ensure efficient and accurate fulfillment of customer and business orders.

This role will implement and manage warehouse management systems, safety procedures, and compliance standards while driving operational excellence. The Warehouse & Fulfillment Manager will be responsible for optimizing warehouse layout and space utilization, monitoring KPIs, and ensuring timely and accurate order fulfillment.

Additionally, this role will manage warehouse staff scheduling, training, and performance to maintain high productivity and safety standards. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, and capable of leading a high-performing warehouse team to support the company’s growth and customer satisfaction goals.

Manages warehouse operations including receiving, storage, picking, packing, and order processing
Implements warehouse management systems and processes to maintain accurate stock levels
Manages warehouse staff scheduling, training, and performance to maintain productivity standards
Implements safety procedures and maintains compliance with warehouse safety regulations
Develops and monitors warehouse operational KPIs for continuous improvement
Manages warehouse space utilization and layout optimization to maximize efficiency and capacity
Oversees order fulfillment processes to ensure accuracy and timely processing

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field (professional certification such as APICS, CPIM, or CSCP preferred).
Minimum of 5+ years’ experience in warehouse management, fulfillment operations, or logistics, preferably in ecommerce, FMCG, or manufacturing environments.
Strong knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS), inventory control, and order fulfillment processes.
Proven ability to manage and lead warehouse teams with strong scheduling, training, and performance management skills.
Experience in warehouse layout design, space optimization, and process improvement initiatives.
Solid understanding of safety regulations, compliance standards, and best practices in warehouse operations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to track and act on KPIs.
Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments including supply chain, operations, and customer service.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

Warehouse Productivity
Pick Accuracy %
Order Processing Time
Safety Incidents (minimize)
Space Utilization %
Staff Efficiency
Fulfillment Accuracy %

## Description ##
## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
The Inventory Manager carries out auditing activities, collects data related to the on-site costs and stocks to support the Supply Warehouse & Cost Control Manager in preparing structured reports concerning the island procurement and logistic operations. Processes RDA and ensures all orders are sent to procurement in a timely matter.

The purpose of this position is to supervise and coordinate the activities of those engaged in inventory management and to ensure that optimum levels of inventory is maintained and that it is at par with quality standards. They are also responsible for keeping track of inventory records and making sure it is accurate.
To consistently exceed guest expectations and provide the highest level of product and services, additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as needed by the Supply Warehouse & Cost Control Manager and / or General Manager. This position is based on MSC's private island reserve, Ocean Cay, staff accommodation is provided.

* Ensures the accuracy of data concerning consumption, stocks, and any internal movements.
· Follows approved budgets. Communicates any fluctuation from these budgets in a timely manner to department managers.
· Maintains and follows the onsite inventory procedures, stocks, consumption, supply chain and warehousing operations.
· Carries out regular audits to ensure accuracy and efficiency of any process concerned.
· Assists Supply Warehouse & Cost Control Manager in preparation of structured reports of the auditing activities and implements immediate corrective action.
· To maintain all documents and records accurately on file and available for inspection for a minimum of 12 months.
· Implement and maintain effective cost control in all areas of consumables without negatively affecting quality, guest service or product.
· Works proactively to avoid shortages, wastage and incurring additional expenses due to lack of proper planning.
· Communicates low stock levels and slow-moving inventory to department managers for proper proactive planning. Identifies changes in requisition trends and works to ensure RDAs are adjusted.
· Assists Supply Warehouse & Cost Control Manager with the Procurement & Logistic on-site operations
· Ensure compliance with the Company-s Policy & Procedures
· Ensure nothing is delivered without an authorized requisition form and that these are signed with authorizing signature.
· Supervises and participates in loading operations.
· Manages proper daily use of all provided company equipment. Ensuring it is used safely, with respect to managing our assets and that it is securely stored, recharged and regularly maintained.
· Trains storekeeping staff on the correct use of all provided equipment.
## Your Journey so far ##
* Minimum 18 years of age and in good health with no physical limitations
· Should be able to demonstrate collaborative work style, strong leadership skills and should have the ability to take proper decision and action whenever any difficult situation arises.
· They should have excellent English oral and written communication skills.
· Good analytical and organizational skills with experience in project management would prove to be an advantage.
· They should have a desire to learn every detail related to inventory operation and have the passion to reach out for promotional opportunities.
· They should enjoy clerical and administrative work with good planning and numeric skills.
· They have a methodical approach to complete the assigned work and possess strong attention to detail.
· A good basic knowledge of all products used in MSC in the hotel, Ocean Cay, technical. (Consumables, chemicals, uniforms, spare parts, etc). Good knowledge of all products in the food and beverage operation, above average computer knowledge, and will be extremely reliable and company minded.
· Excellent knowledge of MMS, Fidelio, Microsoft Programs, XL, POS, network.
· Valid current documentation certifying the health and fitness of the applicant meets all requirements for Ocean Cay personnel based on Ocean Cay MSC Marine Reserve.
· Proven understanding of MSC sanitation standard protocols.
· Previous cruise ship or hotel/resort experience preferable.
· The minimum qualification required to be eligible for this position is that you have completed a bachelor's degree in business related to inventory management, accounting, logistics, etc., from an accredited college or university or equivalent work experience in inventory management.
